ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism in the diagram is important because it returns nutrients back to the soil?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a food web. At the lower left, there are mushroom/fungus-like organisms, labeled “decomposers and detritivores”. The figure also labels grizzly bear, red-tailed hawk, chipmunk, marmot, grouse, deer, berries and flowers, grasses, seeds, etc. The question asks which kind of organism is important because it can return nutrients to the soil. The ones that can decompose dead matter and cycle nutrients back into the soil are decomposers, so the answer is Decomposers.
